payload.scope: Five things, in the order they must work. (1) FIX THE ACTION: the answer topic is absolutized against its base before it reaches the card, so a tap actually posts - the defect the owner found, fixed the way v1 does it. (2) THE CARD READS LIKE A GATE: v1's shape ported - a title naming the iteration and the gate, high priority and a distinguishing tag for a gate versus an ordinary question, and up to three actions with the third slot reserved for the brief's link when one exists. (3) THE HOSTED BRIEF: one self-contained page per bless moment carrying the gate's brief and evidence fields, encrypted, published to Workers KV with an expiry, its key riding only the URL fragment, verified servable BEFORE the notification goes out. (4) THE LADDER IS EXPLICIT: the tier is chosen per gate - brief-plus-actions when the page publishes and verifies, actions alone when it does not - so a host failure degrades rather than blocks. (5) THE LANE STOPS BEING SILENT: every publish records success or failure where the agent and the owner can see it, and the configuration is read when it is needed rather than only at board startup.
payload.non_goals:
- BLESS-WITH-CHANGES on the page (checkbox-edited selections returning selections plus a base hash): specified for this tier in the design, deliberately deferred until the plain bless is proven.
- The cone rendered as collapsed colour-coded rows (v1's adr-handoff-html in full): the page carries the offer's brief and evidence; the cone is a later enrichment of the same page.
- Any change to what a gate MEANS, to the hash binding, or to the accepted-risk authenticity model - this iteration moves the decision to the owner, it does not redefine adjudication.
- The artifact tier and plain chat: unchanged, still available as lower rungs.
- Slack, and any second channel: deferred in v1, still deferred.
- Self-hosting ntfy or adding access tokens: the stated upgrade path, not this iteration.
- Restoring the parallel battery, the machine rework, the board panels, and reading archived iterations from git: routed to the engine-determinizer home, i11, i9 and i5e respectively.
- Automating the Cloudflare account setup: it stays a one-time manual step, as the design records it.
